general_information.Description: Main objectives: Create a professional digital animation project following the design process: Research, define problems, reasons & goals, target audiences, competitors, define art directions, create moodboards, animation directions, scope of works, production timeline, throughout to the final products. The final products must present strong aesthetic abilities, acting skills in animation following 12 principles of animations, editing & composing techniques. The final works should bring a certain meaning to the community. Selected fields including: 2D Animated short film; 3D Animated short film; Stop-motion film; mixed-media film; Game (if the student passed ANO301). Students must work in a group. The number of members for each group, decided by the Head Academic of campus, could be variable from 2 to 3 students The project is done in 4 stages with feedback and discussion at each stage. Students are expected to discuss, organise, present and critique their work with a high level of professionalism, and implement research strategies that contribute to the overall finished project 1) Progress on Project (04 reports): 45% - Report 1: 15% - Report 2: 10% - Report 3: 10% - Report 4: 10% Mark of each report must be >= 4/10; 2) Final Documents (By Instructor): 5% Final Documents (By Instructor) >=4 3) Project Defense - Final Documents (By Council): 20%; - Oral Project Defense: 30% Project Defense >=4 4) Final results:100%; Final Result >=5/10 Final Document and Final Product must be submitted before deadline For Animation film, max 3 students in a group. For other options, max 2 students in a group.
general_information.StudentTasks: (1)Choose the project within the selected concentration (2)Divide and schedule work (3)Students are required to attend at least 80% of scheduled meetings with their supervisor(s) to be eligible for the thesis or capstone defense. (4)Produce document and product according to project requirement (5)Defense individually work in front of examination board

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Research the project topic and synthesize key issues in order to develop a screenplay concept aligned with the artistic direction and objectives of the project.
Evaluate research insights to justify and refine a screenplay concept that aligns with the artistic direction and objectives of the project
Apply character development principles, storyboard design techniques, and animatic creation tools to construct a draft version of the animated film.
Apply layout design, background composition, and character animation techniques to complete animated scenes.
Apply post-production knowledge to design visual and sound effects in order to finalize the animation product according to technical standards.
Apply project planning and collaboration tools to develop a work plan, assign tasks, and demonstrate autonomy, initiative, and a sense of responsibility.
Present and defend the animated product professionally through structured design documentation (poster, slides), using appropriate presentation and critical response language.
Use AI tools in design research and production ethically and effectively, including paraphrasing, content generation, and verification while maintaining academic integrity.
